info.name: User Service
info.description:
Complete API collection for the User Microservice (default port 3501).

**Variables to configure:**
| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | `http://localhost:3501` |
| `token` | JWT access token from auth-service |
| `userId` | Target user MongoDB ObjectId |
| `addressId` | Target address MongoDB ObjectId |

**Auth:** All protected routes use `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`.
